lines.en: I move along the cracked ground
My back arches with each step
I sniff the dry grass
My tail drags on the ground
I slip out of a rock crevice
My prints stay in the dust
I circle the edge of the pen
I walk silent toward the pen
My strides are light and long
I skirt a dead shrub
I head for the sand beyond the village
I keep my head low as I go
I lie on a rock and wait
The spines on my back stand up
My tongue is long and thin
I rub my claws in the sand
I stay still, two eyes only
I open and close my mouth slowly
I wait for it to get darker
I watch the shapes in the pen

lines.zh: 干草堆后面，我等着牲口
lines.en: Behind the hay I wait for livestock
In all this dry hay smell, your sweat is loudest.
You smell of livestock
My eyes shine in the dark
I turn slowly your way
Did your dog stay behind

lines.zh: 我看见你腰后的刀柄了。
lines.en: I can see the hilt behind your hip.
Your torch does not frighten me
I edge forward
I am looking at the blood in you
I dart to one side
One of my spines has broken
That found bone
I arch my back and back off
My tongue pulls back in
I flatten and pause
I can still leap again
Do not think I am unsteady
My hide pulls tighter
You set meat on the ground
This is not alive enough
I come close and stop
Your livestock is better than this
I take the meat away
Cooked meat does not interest me
I carry it back to my den

lines.zh: 你手里那点活物，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the living thing in your hands.
You hit my bony frame
I give way like cloth
My claw catches you
I hold my footing
We kick up dust
You back off, and I stare
My bones knock loudly
I did not like that
I growl and shift sideways
Others of my kind live in the dry land
I smell one from far off
We rarely gather
Each of us keeps a hunting ground
That is not my concern
I mind only the night
I lift my head and call
An answer comes from far away
I lower my head and walk on
We do not hunt together
I crunch it in my teeth
This is not blood at all
I drop it and walk on
I drag it into a crevice
I toy with it twice
I sniff and leave it
It lodges in my teeth
I prefer something softer
Something living is in the pen
I heard footsteps
I drop my head first
You are over by the pen
Let me test you first
My teeth are ready
This prey will fight
I come in from the side
I do not mean to let you go
My claws tighten on the ground
Your smell makes me hungry
I catch the smell of warmth
You are in my hunting ground
I need not hide from you
I glance once at the pen
I circle you slowly
You are backing toward the pen
I stay inside your shadow
I wait for you to look down
I have lifted a forepaw
I know which way you will run
I come half a step nearer
I stay at your rear quarter

lines.zh: 圈里的牲畜，我先挑一只。
lines.en: From the pen, I pick one first.
The flame in your hand is shaking
I know how many walls the pen has
You turn quickly, I am patient
I make one circuit of the pen
I wait for the dogs to bark first
I stretch a forepaw out

lines.zh: 我伏在暗处数你的步子
lines.en: I count your steps from the dark
My teeth sink into your shoulder
My claws rake your leg
I leap onto you
I bite your wrist
My claws open the air
One bound and I am on you
Fine teeth, but they bite deep
You are thrown back two steps
I butt your chest
My tail sweeps your legs
I bear down on you
I claw once more
You cover your throat
I bite into your ribs
I land on your back
My claws hook into you
I snap at your face
I tear at your coat hem
I bite your knee from below
Something stirs behind the dry rocks
I rise out of the dead grass
A pair of eyes lights first

lines.zh: 沙地上多了一个瘦影子
lines.en: A lean shadow joins the sand
I shake the sand off my back
I stop outside the pen
The wind scatters my scent
I slide down the bank
A low sound joins the night
I walk slowly into the moonlight
I come down over loose stones
I appear behind the pen
Fire shrivels my hide
My bones rattle on landing

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，我直蹬腿
lines.en: Water fills my throat and I kick
The blast flips me over
An arrow passes through my shoulder
Magic sears me into a spasm
Too long without prey on this dry land
Lightning lights my spine white
I thrash as I fall
